-

## PR Type

- [ ] Feature PR: `feature/* -> staging`
- [ ] Production promotion PR: `staging -> main`

## Commit And Merge

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] Intended merge method follows repository policy

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] Other:

## Risks And Follow-Ups

-

## Documentation

- [ ] README, durable docs, AGENTS, skills, initiative docs, and backlog were
      updated where needed, or the PR explains why no update is required

## Codex Review

Feature PRs targeting `staging` must include
`@codex review in Brazilian Portuguese` exactly once.

Production promotion PRs from `staging` to `main` must omit the trigger.
